title: Anodana kubva kuMadziva
intro: Fungidzira mweya wakapihwa shoko raMwari, asi wakangoerekana wabva kuvanhu vake pasina mvumo yakajeka. Rwendo urwu rwakavatungamirira mumuedzo unoshamisa, muedzo mukuru wekutsungirira nekuvimba neWekumusoro-soro. Ndiani munhu uyu ane nyaya inotidzidzisa nezvekupfidza nehukuru hwetsitsi dzaAllah?
clues: Ndakatumirwa kurudzi rukuru, asi kurambwa kwavo kwekutanga kwakandishungurudza.
Ndakasiya vanhu vangu, ndichifunga kuti basa rangu rakanga rapera, ndisati ndapiwa murairo wakajeka wekuti ndibve.
Ndakatsvaga nzira yekufamba nechikepe, asi dutu guru uye kurongwa kwemijenya zvakaita kuti pave nemamiriro ezvinhu akaoma.
Ndakakandwa mugungwa, uye chisikwa chine simba chegungwa chakandimedza chose.
Ndiri murima redumbu rayo, ndakadana kuna Allah, ndichibvuma kutadza kwangu uye ndichikumbira ruregerero rwavo.
Allah vakarayira chisikwa ichi kuti chindikande pamhenderekedzo yegungwa, uye ndakaporeswa pasi pemuti wakasiyana.
verse: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy. (37:142)
